lines.text: Micah tells the leaders of Jacob to know justice, yet they hate good, love evil, and tear the skin from God's people.
When the leaders cry out to the LORD, He will not answer them and will hide His face.
Night comes over the prophets who lead the people astray, and the seers and diviners cover their mouths because God gives no answer.
Micah, filled with power by the king's court, declares their sin to Israel and says they build Zion with bloodshed.

wrong_details.wrong: filled with power by the king's court
wrong_details.true: filled with power by the Spirit of the LORD

lines.text: Leaders judge for a bribe, priests teach for a price, and Micah says Zion will be rebuilt with gold.

wrong_details.wrong: Zion will be rebuilt with gold
wrong_details.true: Zion will be plowed like a field
